item.title: U.S. Hockey Team Advances to Gold Medal Game at Olympics
item.description: MILAN (AP) — The much-anticipated but never guaranteed U.S.-Canada showdown for gold in men’s hockey at the Olympics is on. Jack Hughes scored two goals, including one with a highlight-reel individual effort, and the Americans rolled into the final by routing Slovakia 6-2 in the semifinals on Friday night. item.title: Notre Dame Rallies to Beat CAK 87-85 in Triple Overtime
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Notre Dame never gave up in the region tournament semifinals. After falling behind 18-points at halftime, the Irish rallied for an 87-85 win over CAK in triple overtime. The Irish advance to the championship game on Saturday afternoon. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Boyd Buchanan Dunks on Silverdale to Advance to Region Finals
item.description: Chattanooga, TN-(WDEF-TV) Boyd Buchanan threw down a few dunks in the second half to knock off Silverdale 59-48 in the semifinals of their region tournament. The Bucs advance to the region championship game on Saturday evening. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: McCallie Wins Rubber Match Against Baylor 58-53
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) After splitting their regular season matchups, Baylor and McCallie hooked up for a third time Friday in their East Region tournament. The Blue Tornado prevailed by a final of 58-53. Trell Knight had a big three-pointer with roughly 2:30 to play t o put McCallie up six, and it gave the Blue Tornado enough cushion for the win.
